semantic_negative_mutation: Inject a nonempty local clip reference into a group whose clip_mask is None.
mechanical_invariant: ID spelling, defs placement, serialization bytes, and whether an unused definition is emitted are immaterial; the owner-to-clip semantic edge must remain absent.
witness: Render a child rectangle extending across the whole group with clip_mask=None; witness any loss of visible area attributable to an added group clip.

semantic_negative_mutation: Serialize a representable Rect clip with width or height taken from the outer page/group bounds instead of inner_width and inner_height.
mechanical_invariant: The clip may be encoded as rect or an equivalent path, with any local ID and defs order.
witness: Use a child painted both inside and just outside a smaller inner rectangle; witness survival outside the intended rectangle or removal strictly inside it.

semantic_negative_mutation: Collapse a RoundedRect clip to one radius, swap two unequal corner radii, or emit a plain rectangle.
mechanical_invariant: Arc command choice, path starting point, segment spelling, and equivalent closed-path rotation are mechanical.
witness: Use four distinct transported corner radii and paint probes near every corner; witness a probe whose visibility differs from the four-radius rounded region.

semantic_negative_mutation: Replace an Ellipse clip with its rectangular bounding box or derive one ellipse axis from the wrong dimension.
mechanical_invariant: Ellipse element versus an equivalent path, ID spelling, and numeric lexical formatting are mechanical.
witness: Paint probes inside the bounding-box corners but outside the intended ellipse plus one probe strictly inside; witness corner survival or interior loss.

semantic_negative_mutation: Drop, reorder, reverse with changed nonzero winding effect, or geometrically alter a transported Path subpath or curve.
mechanical_invariant: Equivalent path command normalization, absolute versus relative commands, and cyclic choice of a closed subpath's start are mechanical.
witness: Use a finite nonzero path with multiple subpaths including a hole or disjoint lobe; witness visible content in a region whose nonzero membership changed.

semantic_negative_mutation: When applying a descendant clip, replace rather than intersect the ancestral clip, or omit the descendant clip.
mechanical_invariant: Separate nested clip references versus a semantically equivalent pre-intersected region are mechanical when the resolved visible intersection is identical.
witness: Use partially overlapping ancestral and descendant rectangles and paint in ancestor-only, descendant-only, intersection, and outside regions; witness visibility anywhere except the intersection.

semantic_negative_mutation: Apply group position or transform to the clip zero times or twice while applying it once to the children, or vice versa.
mechanical_invariant: Whether the shared transform is carried on a g, clipPath, geometry, or an equivalent local wrapper is mechanical if clip and children share one basis.
witness: Use a translated, non-uniformly transformed group with a clipped child crossing the local boundary; witness relative displacement or deformation between the clip edge and child.

semantic_negative_mutation: Emit a dangling clip-path reference, resolve it to a different local definition, or create duplicate local IDs with ambiguous ownership.
mechanical_invariant: The concrete ID token, url quoting, href spelling where equivalent, and defs position are mechanical.
witness: Resolve every owner clip-path edge in the emitted semantic graph; witness zero or multiple targets, or a unique target whose region differs from the owner's required clip.

semantic_negative_mutation: Make clip semantics depend on identifier spelling or definition order so that alpha-renaming or reordering equivalent definitions changes resolution or visible clipping.
mechanical_invariant: Alpha-renaming and permutation of definitions are required metamorphic invariants; byte identity and stable numeric suffixes are not.
witness: Take one resolved graph, bijectively rename all clip IDs and references and reorder its definitions; witness any owner-target, spatial, geometric, or visible-region change.

semantic_negative_mutation: Promote an even-odd-dependent Path clip as preserved while interpreting it with nonzero winding.
mechanical_invariant: Path command spelling, subpath start, ID token, and defs order do not cure the absent fill-rule carrier.
witness: Use two same-winding nested closed subpaths whose center is outside under even-odd and inside under nonzero; witness center content surviving together with a preservation claim.

semantic_negative_mutation: Claim an alpha-dependent clip_mask request is preserved by a solid geometric clip, mask/filter/opacity substitution, or rasterization.
mechanical_invariant: Choice among SVG mask machinery, filter syntax, opacity placement, raster encoding, and ID spelling cannot establish equivalence for this geometric-only contract.
witness: Use a mask with at least two nonzero alpha levels over otherwise identical painted content; witness a preservation claim or solid binary visibility where graded alpha visibility is required.

semantic_negative_mutation: For nonfinite, incomplete, or unrepresentable clip geometry, claim preservation, silently treat the clip as absent, or silently remove the children.
mechanical_invariant: NaN/Infinity lexical spelling, diagnostic attribute spelling, and unsupported-representation encoding are mechanical; an explicit Unknown/CONTRACT-GAP disposition is semantic.
witness: Supply one missing or nonfinite required dimension/control and a visibly painted child; witness Preserved, silent full visibility, or silent empty visibility instead of explicit Unknown/CONTRACT-GAP.
